# Run the Entire demo (.context/entire-demo.md)

## Context
Commit e8a8856 enabled Entire on `charlesbeaumont/capture-launcher-bear-check`. The demo proves Entire end to end with a small real fix: commit, check the checkpoint trailer, push, check the checkpoint refs, open a PR. `entire status` shows the repo enabled, syncing checkpoints to `origin`, with this session active.

The fix: Bear briefly lists a new note with an empty title. `BearProvider.destinations(from:)` caches it as a blank picker row.

## Steps
1. Edit `Sources/Destinations/BearProvider.swift:29`. Add `!note.title.isEmpty` to the existing `guard`:
   ```swift
   guard note.id != DestinationStore.inboxNoteId,
         !note.title.isEmpty,
         let kind = kind(forTags: note.tags) else { return nil }
   ```
2. Build: `xcodegen generate && xcodebuild -project Capture.xcodeproj -scheme Capture -configuration Debug build`. Stop and report if it fails.
3. Commit only that file: `fix(bear): skip notes with an empty title`, body explaining the blank cached row, Claude co-author trailer. Run `git log -1` and confirm an `Entire-Checkpoint:` trailer.
4. `git push -u origin charlesbeaumont/capture-launcher-bear-check`. Run `git ls-remote origin` and confirm checkpoint refs (e.g. `refs/entire/...`) are listed.
5. Run `entire checkpoint list` (read-only) and capture its output.
6. `gh pr create --base main`. Title covers both commits (Entire enablement + empty-title fix). Body: one line per commit, the `entire checkpoint list` output in a code block, then the Claude Code footer.

## Verification
- Build succeeds (step 2).
- `git log -1` shows `Entire-Checkpoint:` (step 3).
- `git ls-remote origin` lists checkpoint refs (step 4).
- `gh pr view --web`-free check: `gh pr view` returns the PR URL.

If the trailer or refs are missing, report it with the output rather than working around it. Never run `entire enable/disable/clean/auth`.
